method.access: SQLite mode=ro; existing VIDEO metadata only; no inference or index loading
method.sql:
SELECT v.id,m.path,v.timestamp,f.bbox_x,f.bbox_y,f.bbox_w,f.bbox_h,
                f.age,f.is_male,f.detection_score
         FROM vectors v JOIN media m ON m.id=v.media_id
         JOIN vector_metadata_insightface f ON f.vector_id=v.id
         WHERE v.feature_extractor_id=? AND v.modality=? ORDER BY v.id
method.alignment: same unique media basename and timestamp rounded to 4 decimals; greedy maximum bbox IoU >= 0.9; process vector IDs ascending

limitations: Aggregated metadata consistency, not demographic or identity accuracy.
Does not read registration names, photos, or embedding vectors.
The full-batch +1 year result and the separate preview-image smoke -1 year result concern different inputs; do not combine their denominators or directions.
